tools.name: estimate_build
tools.description: What a LEVA building of a given size costs to build: total, materials, labour (execution) and hours in USD with a low-high range, from LEVA's priced reference designs of that product, plus the nearest reference design and a link that opens LEVA's 3D configurator at exactly that size with an itemized

tools.name: list_products
tools.description: List LEVA's configurable building products (A-frame, ADU, shed, sauna, barndominium ...) with their configurator type, the number of priced reference designs and whether their options are described.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: One LEVA product by its handle (e.g. a-frames, adu): description, plan price, configuration options (sizes, roof, foundation ...) and LEVA's reference designs with their itemized budgets (materials, execution/labour, hours, $/sq ft; USD estimates, not quotes).

tools.name: get_project
tools.description: One public LEVA project by the id from its link (?p=<id>): a LEVA reference design or a budget its author made public -- plan size, rooms, roof, place, and the budget (total, materials, execution, hours; USD estimates, not quotes).

tools.name: get_product_prices
tools.description: What the materials of a LEVA product's reference design (or default design) cost at the cheapest store offers, day by day, in 19 countries (local currency and USD), with coverage and the change over time. Materials only; estimates, not quotes.

tools.name: get_project_prices
tools.description: One LEVA reference design's own bill of quantities priced at the cheapest store offers, day by day, in every country (USD), with coverage. Materials only; estimates, not quotes.

tools.name: search_items
tools.description: Find items of LEVA's material catalogue (doors, windows, lumber, insulation, fasteners, membranes ...) by words, e.g. 'interior door', 'exterior door 36', 'window'. Gives ids for get_item_prices.

tools.name: get_item_prices
tools.description: The cheapest offer found for one LEVA catalogue item, per unit, in each country's currency and USD, over time; checked against LEVA's own price and the other countries (pack prices replaced).

tools.name: get_latest_project
tools.description: The newest public project a LEVA user shared (not a LEVA reference design): product, author, place, size and the budget (total, materials, execution, hours; USD estimates, not quotes), with its link.
